about: The project's own list for INV-08 (the second reader of every placed model's base-colour map): words the reader finds on a CC0 model's map that a person has looked at at 100 per cent and judged not a maker's name, a brand or a mark (a generic instruction or a material). Anything else the reader finds fails the build. 15 Oct 2026, the ironmonger's try 2 close review, narrow 1.

allowed.why: a material and a process stamped on a spanner's jaw, read at 100 per cent: no maker's name, no brand
a generic instruction on a cap, read at 100 per cent: no brand
the word on a dial's face (a thermometer's scale with numbers), read at 100 per cent: no maker, no brand
a line of 'Push to open' (the reader splits it in two), read at 100 per cent: a generic instruction on a cap, no brand
a line of 'Push to open' (the reader splits it in two), read at 100 per cent: a generic instruction on a cap, no brand
the reader's second reading of THERMOMETER (the dial's word, read at 100 per cent)
